info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Customer Reviews Submission API
info.description: The Customer Reviews Submission API allows users to submit reviews for payment executions within the banking system. This feature was designed for financial institutions looking to gather feedback on transaction experiences, enabling them to enhance customer satisfaction and improve service delivery. Typical consumers include banking developers and product managers aiming to integrate customer insights into their service offerings. It supports streamlined data collection for quality assessments and operational improvements, ensuring a more transparent and customer-centric approach to service evaluation.

post.summary: Create a Review for Payment Execution
post.description: This endpoint allows you to create a review for a specific payment execution identified by its unique identifier. Provide feedback on the payment execution process to enhance service quality and accountability.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to submit reviews for the specified payment execution identified by PAY-300045. The review provides feedback and ratings that can influence future payment experiences.
